description: This is an abstract test class for MQTT client actors in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains setup methods, several test cases for connecting, disconnecting, testing connections, message consumption, and publishing over MQTT, as well as utility methods for creating test messages and sources.

classes.name: AbstractMqttClientActorTest
classes.description: An abstract test class providing setup, utility methods, and common test cases for MQTT client actor implementations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It facilitates testing connection, disconnection, message exchange, and error handling.

methods.name: createFailingClientActor
methods.description: Abstract method to create a client actor that simulates failure scenarios, intended to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: createClientActorWithMessages
methods.description: Creates a client actor with predefined messages to simulate incoming MQTT messages during tests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: mqttMessage
methods.description: Constructs a test MQTT message with given topic and payload, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts payload string from a received message, implementation depends on the message type.

methods.name: extractTopic
methods.description: Extracts topic string from a received message, implementation depends on the message type.

methods.name: getMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object of the message type used in this test, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that disconnect logic was invoked, implementation provided by subclasses.
